Name: Traveler Snail - Mount
Author: takdelife
Description:
[size=6][b](CP)(AT) Traveler Snail - Mount[/b][/size]

Lore: Long ago, when the world was still young, there lived the Ancient Traveler Snail—the fastest snail in the universe. Kingdoms once relied on these mighty creatures for transportation, their shells carving paths across distant lands. Legends claim the Traveler Snail could outrun even the swiftest horse… (real)

_______________________________________________________________________________________

[b]How to use:
1. You need Content Patcher or Alternative Texture 
2. Alternative Texture : buy scissor from Robin and use it on the horse
3. Content Patcher : You can change the snail on the mod config.
4: Enjoy!
